Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 28  
Reason for Mistake:  
The first clear mistake was made when WebSurfer downloaded the wrong PDF file. At step 28, it reported successfully downloading `ojsboss,+Journal+manager,+16_243-1254-2-PB.pdf`, which is not the University of Leicester paper “Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet?”. This wrong file path/content mismatch meant the subsequent search was carried out on the incorrect document, preventing the agent from finding the fish bag volume and leading the conversation away from the real answer.
